summary: TASK-104 improves the Alpamayo OOD batch summary and produces a three-case open-loop Alpamayo+memory evidence batch from existing live comparison artifacts. The report is honest about claim boundaries and does not claim closed-loop control.

finding_log.summary: The batch reuses existing live comparison artifacts instead of launching new remote inference, so it strengthens aggregation and presentation but does not add new model runs.
evidence: The batch contains 3 passed records from archived comparison artifacts.
Claim boundaries explicitly state open-loop policy evaluation and closed-loop control false.
finding_log.next_action: Use this batch in V7 packaging; only run new remote inference if a missing final case becomes worth the runtime cost.
